thread.message: Our corporate card keeps getting declined and we would really like to pay a different way. Is there a bank transfer option for us?
Happy to help. Payment method availability depends on your plan and region. Could you confirm which plan your workspace is on?
We are on the Enterprise plan, in the US.

query: So is a wire transfer an option for us, or do we need to talk to our account manager to set that up?
expected_intent: apply Enterprise wire transfer eligibility to a confirmed plan in a multi-turn exchange
required_facts: Wire transfer is available to qualifying Enterprise customers, typically as part of a signed Enterprise agreement
Eligibility and instructions are defined per agreement
Wire payments may be on custom terms, including purchase orders or custom invoices

thread.message: We signed up on January 31 and I am trying to plan our finance budget. When is the next charge?
Monthly subscriptions renew on the same calendar day as the original subscription date, so your renewal follows that day each month.
Right, but we signed up on the 31st of January. February does not have a 31st.

query: So we get billed on the 28th in February and then go back to the 31st in March?
expected_intent: confirm the fallback rule for a renewal day that does not exist in a month
required_facts: If the renewal day does not exist in a month, the workspace is billed on the final day of that month
A January 31 subscription is billed on February 28 in a non-leap February
The renewal returns to the 31st in months that have a 31st

thread.message: I have not received my invoice for this month's charge, and the charge posted today.
Invoices are generated at each billing cycle close and become available in Workspace Settings → Billing under Invoices. A notification email is also sent to the billing contact.
I am the billing contact, but I do not see an email with the invoice in it.

query: So where exactly is the invoice if it is not attached to the email?
expected_intent: clarify that the email is only a notification and the invoice lives in the workspace
required_facts: The notification email is sent to the billing contact but does not include a PDF attachment by default
The full invoice, including line items, is always available in the Workspace Billing section under Invoices
Monthly invoices are generally available the day the charge posts

thread.message: I need proof of a $192.00 payment we made earlier this month for our accounting team.
You can find it in Workspace Settings → Billing. Select Invoices, open the invoice for that cycle, then choose Receipt to view the payment receipt.
I opened the invoice but I only see the line items and the total. I do not see anything labeled Receipt.

query: Am I looking in the wrong place, or is the receipt stored somewhere else?
expected_intent: re-explain that the receipt is linked to the payment on the invoice
required_facts: Receipts are linked to the payments on your invoices
Open the relevant invoice and select Receipt to view the payment receipt
Then select Download to save a copy

thread.message: Our monthly charge failed a few days ago and we got an email about it. We are a bit worried.
That is expected — you are now in the automatic retry phase. There is a grace period of up to 7 days from the first failure to update your payment method.
OK, so what if we just wait it out and do nothing?

query: What actually happens to our account if we ignore it past day 7?
expected_intent: explain past-due and restriction/suspension consequences of not acting
required_facts: If no valid payment method is available after the grace period, the subscription enters a past-due state
Continued non-payment may lead to restriction then suspension, typically around 14 days from the first failure
Restriction and suspension are collection measures and do not cancel the subscription

thread.message: Our card was declined on the renewal charge and we want to add a different card to our account.
You can update it anytime in Workspace Settings → Billing → Payment Method. Add the new card and set it as the default.
OK, I just added the new card and it is showing as the default now.

query: So what happens to the charge that failed? Will they try the new card automatically?
expected_intent: confirm pending retries are attempted against the valid method on file
required_facts: Any pending retry of a failed payment will use the valid method on file
A new payment attempt is made automatically where available
Updating the payment method during the grace period avoids restriction or suspension

thread.message: I got asked to verify my card when I added it, and I approved it in my bank's app. Is that normal?
Yes, that is the 3D Secure / SCA check. Once you complete the challenge, return to the Workspace Billing section and confirm the payment status.
I did approve it, but I am not sure the charge actually posted.

query: If it still did not go through after I approved it, what happens next?
expected_intent: explain the dunning path if the payment did not post after the challenge
required_facts: If the payment did not go through, the standard dunning process applies and a retry may occur
A 3D Secure check is not a declined payment by itself; the payment may still succeed once the challenge is completed
If the challenge was not completed, the charge may not have posted

thread.message: We just moved our billing to an India address and the new invoice has a GST line on it. Can you tell me the rate you applied?
GST is the terminology used for tax in India. The applicable rate depends on the jurisdiction and the details on file — AcmeFlow does not publish a single GST percentage.
I see, so there is no fixed AcmeFlow GST rate at all then?

query: Then how do I know what percentage was applied on my invoice?
expected_intent: explain the GST line reflects the applicable jurisdiction's rate and where to see it
required_facts: Taxes appear as a line item on invoices where applicable
The GST rate shown is specific to the applicable jurisdiction and is not a published AcmeFlow rate
The tax shown is calculated for the billing address and jurisdiction on file at the time the invoice is generated

thread.message: We relocated and I need to update the billing address on our account so our invoices are correct.
You can update it in Workspace Settings → Billing → Billing Address. The new address applies to invoices generated after the change.
And our billing contact, who receives the invoice emails — I will update that separately, right?

query: Changing the address will not automatically change who gets the invoice emails, correct?
expected_intent: confirm billing address and billing contact are separate
required_facts: The billing address is the address on your invoices and is used for tax
The billing contact is the person who receives invoice notifications by email
The two can be different and are updated separately in the Workspace

thread.message: We want to stop paying for AcmeFlow. How do we cancel?

You can cancel yourself at any time from Workspace Settings -> Billing -> Manage Subscription -> Cancel Subscription. Review the details on the confirmation screen and confirm. Your subscription will not renew at the end of the current billing period.
ok done. but I didn't get any email about it, is that normal?

query: did my cancellation actually go through?
expected_intent: confirm_cancellation_confirmation
required_facts: A cancellation confirmation is sent to the workspace billing contact by email
A confirmation is also shown in the Billing section after confirming
Cancellation prevents renewal at the end of the current billing period

thread.message: We're cancelling our AcmeFlow subscription. When does it actually end?
Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period, not on the date you confirm. Paid access continues until then.
our billing runs from the 15th and we confirmed on the 2nd

query: so access stops on the 15th?
expected_intent: confirm_access_end_date
required_facts: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period
Renewal occurs on the same calendar day as the original subscription date
Paid access continues until the end of the current billing period

thread.message: What happens to our data after we cancel?
Workspace data is retained for 60 days after your subscription terminates. After that window, data is subject to deletion and deletion may be irreversible.
we terminated at the end of last month, i think around july 15

query: so is our data still around?
expected_intent: confirm_data_within_retention_window
required_facts: The retention window is 60 days measured from the subscription termination date
During the window the workspace data is not immediately deleted
After the window ends data is subject to deletion and may be irreversible

thread.message: We want to close our AcmeFlow account for good. What's the process?

The recommended order is: cancel your subscription first, export the data you need, and then delete the account. Cancelling stops new charges, exporting protects your data, and deleting closes the account.
ok, we already cancelled and exported everything yesterday

query: should we go ahead and delete now?
expected_intent: confirm_delete_after_export
required_facts: The recommended order is cancel, export, then delete
Deletion removes the account and its data and is more permanent
Once data is deleted it may not be possible to restore it

thread.message: We cancelled AcmeFlow a while ago but we're thinking about coming back. Can we?
Yes, you can return to the Pro plan at any time. If you reactivate within 60 days of cancellation you may also keep the same per-user price you paid before.
we cancelled about three weeks ago i think

query: so we'd still get our old price?
expected_intent: confirm_price_lock_applies
required_facts: The price lock is honored if Pro is re-purchased within 60 days of the cancellation date
The price lock retains the same per-user price previously paid
Reactivation within the retention window restores retained workspace data

thread.message: how do we make sure we keep copies of our workflows before leaving?

Export the data you need before you cancel or delete. Open workspace settings, run the export for workflows or reports, and save the files to a location you control. Cancellation does not automatically produce an export.
uh oh we already cancelled and deleted our account without exporting anything

query: is the data gone for good?
expected_intent: confirm_data_loss_after_delete_without_export
required_facts: If you delete the account before you export, the data is removed with the account and cannot be restored
Data deleted after the retention period may be irreversible
Support agents should retrieve the account's actual termination and retention status rather than promising recovery

thread.message: Hi, we just signed our new enterprise agreement and I want to know when our first invoice is going to come out.
Invoices are generated at each billing cycle close and show up in the Workspace Billing section — the exact cycle is defined in your agreement. Do you have your agreement reference handy?
Sure, it's MSAA-2026-0417. The one with quarterly billing.
Thanks. For enterprise accounts the invoice is issued at each billing cycle close, and a PO number appears on the invoice when the agreement calls for one. How else can I help?

query: If we're on quarterly billing, is one purchase order enough for all four invoices this year?
expected_intent: Determine whether one PO covers the whole year or a new PO is needed per billing cycle.
required_facts: PO numbers appear on invoices when the agreement calls for a PO
Purchase order requirements and PO number format are defined in the signed agreement
PO frequency must be verified against the agreement, not assumed

thread.message: We're adding 40 seats next quarter. Does that change what we pay per seat?
Seat changes during an active cycle are typically billed at the prorated discounted rate when a discount is in place, but the mechanics depend on your agreement. Which contract should I reference?
MSAA-2026-0551 — the one with the 5% discount at 200 seats.

query: So after we go to 260 seats, does the 5% still hold, or does the 10% kick in?
expected_intent: Determine which discount tier applies after a seat increase under the agreement.
required_facts: Discount thresholds are defined in the agreement's volume-discount table
Discounts may step up as committed seats pass negotiated thresholds
The applicable tier must be read from the signed agreement

thread.message: Who should I talk to about our renewal pricing next year?
If your account has a dedicated account manager, that person coordinates renewals and contract questions. Let me check your agreement — is there a DAM assigned?
Yes, we have one — Dana. Can she help with our seat forecast?
A dedicated account manager can coordinate seat changes and renewals with your team, while Billing Operations handles the actual changes.

query: So I should loop Dana in on the seat forecast before we talk to billing, right?
expected_intent: Confirm DAM coordination for seat and renewal planning.
required_facts: The DAM coordinates renewals, seat changes, and contract questions with the customer's team
The DAM liaises with Billing Operations and Enterprise Support on the customer's behalf
The DAM does not replace normal support and billing processes

thread.message: We had some downtime on the platform around March 18. Can we get anything for that?
I can help with that. Uptime credits are defined in each agreement — can you confirm your account has a signed SLA, and share the outage dates and times?
It's Meridian Health Partners, we have the standard 99.9% SLA, and it was about 45 minutes on March 18.

query: Does 45 minutes on a single day actually put us under for the month?
expected_intent: Determine whether the reported downtime breaches the monthly uptime target under the agreement.
required_facts: Uptime is measured monthly against the SLA target
Downtime is measured in whole minutes
A credit applies if the downtime qualifies under the agreement's credit terms after validation
AcmeFlow validates reported downtime against uptime monitoring

thread.message: Our compliance team is asking for SOC 2 documentation before we renew.

SOC 2 requests are handled under your agreement's confidentiality terms and are shared through the account team's controlled channel. Do you have an assigned account manager, or should I route this to Enterprise Operations?
We have a DAM — coordinate through them. We also need to sign an NDA first, right?

query: So the NDA needs to be in place before they send the report?
expected_intent: Confirm that confidentiality and non-disclosure terms govern delivery of SOC 2 documentation.
required_facts: SOC 2 documentation is shared under the confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations that apply to the account
Reports are provided through the account team's controlled channel
No report content is shared outside the approved workflow

thread.message: Our March invoice was way higher than I expected. Can you explain the charges?
Happy to help. Could you share the invoice number and which line stood out to you?
It's AF-2026-004821. Total is $240.80 but 8 seats at $24 a month is only $192.
That's right. The invoice includes a $32 prorated charge for 2 seats added on March 12, plus a $16.80 sales tax line. Together with the $192 base charge they total $240.80.

query: So the $32 line is really just the two seats we added on the 12th, right? Nothing else on there?
expected_intent: Confirm the prorated seat addition accounts for the $32 difference
required_facts: the $32 proration came from 2 seats added on March 12
the proration uses the daily per-seat rate over the remaining days of the cycle
the total reconciles to base charge + proration + tax

thread.message: Our latest invoice doesn't have our PO number on it and we need net 30 terms.
Custom invoice features like PO references and net terms apply under a signed Enterprise agreement. Do you have one?
Yes, quarterly agreement with PO-88213 on file.

query: So with our agreement, this invoice should print PO-88213 and be due 30 days from the invoice date, correct?
expected_intent: Confirm PO and net-30 terms from the signed Enterprise agreement
required_facts: the signed agreement requires the PO number and net payment terms
the invoice includes the customer's PO number where the agreement requires it
the due date is computed from the invoice date per the agreement

thread.message: Does adding a PO number change how much we get billed?
No. A PO number is a reference only and does not change what you're billed for.
Good. We just saved PO-2026-8841 in the Billing section a few days ago.

query: So our next invoice will show that PO, but the current one that was already generated won't, right?
expected_intent: Confirm the PO appears only on invoices generated after it was saved
required_facts: the PO appears on invoices generated after it was recorded
an already-generated invoice keeps the reference it was created with
a PO number on file does not change what you are billed for

thread.message: Who gets the invoice notification emails for our workspace?
The billing contact set under Workspace Settings → Billing. It's the address AcmeFlow uses for billing-related email.
It's currently finance@brightpath.example, but our new person is billing@brightpath.example.

query: If we update it now, the next invoice notification goes to the new address?
expected_intent: Confirm the updated billing contact receives the next notification
required_facts: invoice notifications are emailed to the new billing contact starting with the next notification sent
the change is made in the Billing Contact field in Workspace Settings → Billing
if the change is close to a renewal date, the notification for that cycle may still go to the previous address

thread.message: I think we were double charged for March. There are two charges on our card.
Let's take a look. Can you share the invoice and receipt references?
Invoice AF-2026-004821 and receipt AF-RCPT-003418, plus another invoice AF-2026-004822.

query: So those aren't duplicate charges — the second invoice is just the next month's cycle, right?
expected_intent: Confirm the two invoices are separate billing cycles, not a duplicate charge
required_facts: invoice AF-2026-004821 is the March cycle including the prorated seat addition
receipt AF-RCPT-003418 references the same invoice and matches the posted charge
AF-2026-004822 is a separate invoice for the April cycle at the new seat count

thread.message: We're a small design studio evaluating AcmeFlow for our team.
Great - we have three plans. Free is $0 with up to 3 users and 2 workflows, Pro is $24 per user per month (or $20 effective on annual billing), and Enterprise is custom-priced per agreement.
Okay, so what about the middle one?

query: Does the middle one come with audit logs?
expected_intent: pro_audit_logs
required_facts: Audit logs are included on Pro and Enterprise
Pro is $24/user/month monthly or $20/user/month effective on annual billing

thread.message: We're a 12-person ops team looking at AcmeFlow. We need approvals automation and some reporting.
Sure. Free is $0 with 2 workflows and 500 executions per month. Pro is $24/user/month with unlimited workflows, standard analytics, and audit logs. Enterprise is custom.
And the one in the middle had the reporting built in?

query: Yeah, does that one include the reporting?
expected_intent: pro_analytics_availability
required_facts: Standard analytics is included with Pro
Free plan has no analytics feature

thread.message: We added 3 new hires to our Pro workspace on the 10th of this month.
Thanks. Adding seats mid-cycle generates a prorated charge for the rest of the cycle, and the full seat count bills from the next renewal.
Oh, we also removed two people a few days ago.

query: So will we get money back for the people we removed?
expected_intent: seat_removal_refund
required_facts: Removing seats normally affects future billing only
Unused time on removed seats is not automatically refunded unless the applicable policy explicitly permits it

thread.message: We're thinking about switching our 15 seats to annual billing to save money.
Switching monthly to annual is treated as an upgrade - it takes effect immediately and the annual amount may be prorated against your current cycle.
But what if we change our mind later and want to go back?

query: If we switch back to monthly, do we lose the money we already paid?
expected_intent: annual_to_monthly_switch_refund
required_facts: Annual to monthly is a downgrade that takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle (the annual anniversary date)
Unused time on the annual term is not automatically refunded unless the applicable policy explicitly permits it

thread.message: We're expanding into Europe and want to start billing in EUR.
Currency is set at the workspace level, and availability depends on your billing country. We don't publish a fixed conversion rate - the market rate at charge time applies.
Our invoices are in USD though - we just changed the workspace.

query: So should the amount change now that we switched to EUR?
expected_intent: currency_switch_conversion
required_facts: Billed amounts in non-USD currencies are derived from market rates applied when the charge posts
Rates move, so the amount can differ slightly from expectations

thread.message: We upgraded from Free to Pro this morning.
Upgrades take effect immediately, so Pro features are active now. Any additional charge for the rest of your cycle is prorated.
Actually, my boss changed his mind - we need to go back to Free.

query: When would the switch back to Free kick in?
expected_intent: downgrade_effective_date
required_facts: A downgrade takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle
Higher-tier features remain available until then
Unused time on the higher tier is not automatically refunded

thread.message: I signed up for the Pro trial on August 3 for my team.
Great - the standard trial is 14 days and converts to your selected paid plan at the end. You can cancel anytime before conversion with no charge.
I set up monthly Pro with 4 seats during signup.

query: So what's the first charge going to be on the 17th?
expected_intent: trial_conversion_charge
required_facts: The trial converts to the selected paid plan at the end of the 14 days
The first charge is 4 x $24 = $96 for monthly Pro, based on the seat count at conversion

thread.message: Hi, we just cancelled our AcmeFlow Pro subscription.
Thanks for letting us know. Cancelling stops future renewals, but it doesn't automatically create a refund.
Wait, so we don't get anything back at all?

query: But we were charged two weeks ago - does that charge still count for a refund?
expected_intent: confirm a separate charge posted within the last 30 days remains eligible even after cancellation
required_facts: Cancelling a subscription does not automatically create a refund
A separate charge posted within the last 30 days is still subject to the 30-day window even if the subscription is later cancelled
The window is measured from the date the charge posted

thread.message: We're on a 5-seat Pro monthly plan at $24 per user, so $120 a month. We got a prorated refund approved.
Great. I can help you confirm the amount - what's the effective date of the refund?
It's effective the 16th of this 30-day month, so there are 15 unused days.

query: So how much are we getting back?
expected_intent: apply the prorated refund formula: 15/30 x $120 = $60
required_facts: Refund Amount = Eligible Unused Period / Original Billing Period x Eligible Charge
15 unused days out of a 30-day month

thread.message: I'd like a refund for a charge from 45 days ago.
That's outside the standard 30-day window, so it would need to go through our exception approval process.
Got it. What does that involve?

query: Who actually decides whether it gets approved?
expected_intent: explain exceptions are approved by the appropriate approver, typically a Billing Operations manager
required_facts: Exceptions must be approved by the appropriate approver, typically a Billing Operations manager
Higher-value exceptions and Enterprise account exceptions are escalated per procedures
There is no blanket rule that all late requests are approved

thread.message: Our next invoice is $192 and we have a $120 credit balance on the workspace.
That's right - credits are applied automatically to future invoices in the order they're generated.
So on the next invoice...

query: how much will we actually end up paying?
expected_intent: apply the credit to the invoice: $192 - $120 = $72 due
required_facts: Credits are applied automatically to future invoices in order of invoice generation
A credit applied to an invoice reduces the amount due on that invoice

thread.message: My refund to my credit card was processed by AcmeFlow last Tuesday.
Thanks. Card refunds typically appear within 5-10 business days from when we process them.
It's been a full week now and I still don't see it.

query: Is something wrong with it?
expected_intent: confirm the refund is still within the estimate window and nothing is necessarily wrong
required_facts: Card refunds typically take 5-10 business days to appear
Timeframes count in business days from when AcmeFlow processes the refund
Timeframes are estimates and depend on the card issuer

thread.message: We downgraded our Pro workspace from 8 seats to 5 seats on the 12th of this month.
A downgrade takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle, so it affects future billing only.
So for the seats we gave up mid-month...

query: we shouldn't expect any credit for the rest of March, right?
expected_intent: confirm no partial refund or credit for unused seat time after a downgrade
required_facts: A downgrade takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle
Unused time in the current cycle is not automatically refunded unless a policy explicitly allows it
No partial refund is issued for the seat time not used in the current month

thread.message: My renewal charge was way higher than normal this month and I'm really confused.
Happy to help sort that out. Could you share the amount shown, the charge date, the last four digits of the card, and your workspace name?
It was $204.00 on the 1st, card ending 8831. The workspace is Apex Studio and the invoice is AF-2026-005304.

query: So there are two line items on it and one says the amount is from an overdue period. Does that mean I'm being double billed for last month?
expected_intent: Explain that the overdue-period line item is the outstanding balance from a failed cycle collected at renewal, not a duplicate charge
required_facts: invoice ID AF-2026-005304
invoice line items
failed payment and dunning history
charge amount $204.00 and date
card last four digits 8831

thread.message: I think you charged me twice this month.
I can help check that. Can you tell me the amounts, the dates, and the last four digits of the card for each entry on your statement?
Two charges of $192.00 on card ending 4411 — one on the 1st and one on the 2nd.

query: I checked my statement again and both are marked settled. Does that mean it's a double charge for sure?
expected_intent: Verify whether two settled charges cover the same invoice or period before confirming duplication
required_facts: both invoice IDs
payment status of each entry (settled)
charge amounts, dates and card last four digits
covered billing periods

thread.message: My card was charged more than my invoice says. Something is off.
Let me take a look. Could you confirm your workspace currency and the currency of the card you paid with?
The workspace is set to USD and the invoice is $192.00. My card is EUR and my statement shows €176.20.

query: So is that difference just the currency conversion, or did you actually overcharge me?
expected_intent: Confirm the statement amount is a market-rate conversion of the USD invoice, not an overcharge
required_facts: invoice ID and USD amount $192.00
workspace currency USD
card currency EUR
statement amount €176.20
charge date and card last four digits

thread.message: I don't recognize this charge on my Visa, can you check it?
Of course. Can you tell me what the statement line says for the merchant, the amount, the date, and the card's last four digits?
It just says ACMEFLOW, $192.00, on the 1st, card ending 4012.

query: I searched for 'AcmeFlow Inc.' on the statement and it's not there. Is this charge really from you?
expected_intent: Explain that ACMEFLOW is the processor descriptor while AcmeFlow Inc. is the legal entity, and confirm the charge against the matching invoice
required_facts: descriptor text ACMEFLOW
statement amount $192.00 and date
card last four digits 4012
matching invoice ID and line items
